# Plan

1. **Add `check:pricing-sync` to pre-commit hook as a blocking check.**
   - Wire the script into `.husky/pre-commit` (or equivalent hook config) so it runs and blocks commit if pricing sync fails. This catches drift at authoring time before it reaches CI.

2. **Do NOT delete the CI `pricing-sync` job; keep it as a non-blocking check or auditable record.**
   - Pre-commit hooks are easy to bypass (`git commit --no-verify`) and only run on developer machines. Keep the CI job so that any bypassed or out-of-sync pushes (e.g., from automated tools, force-pushes, or team member lapses) are still caught and visible before merge.
